description: Trisport is a sports store in Romania for running, cycling, swimming, triathlon and outdoor. The app searches the live Trisport catalog and shows only products that can be bought now, with today's price in RON, discounts, every size with its own stock and delivery time, and accessories other customers buy together. It creates a link that opens the trisport.ro cart with the chosen products; the customer reviews and pays on the website. After connecting their Trisport account, customers can also see their orders with live courier tracking, their loyalty points and their wishlist, and add products to the wishlist. The app never places orders or takes payments.
